---
title: Issue Reports
description: Triage app problems reported by vendors and agents, update ticket status and reply to the reporter.
---

## Overview

**Sidebar:** Vendors → Comms → **Issue Reports** (`/vendors/issue-reports`)

Vendors (and field agents) can report app problems from their app — with a description, how often it happens, screenshots and voice notes. Each report becomes a ticket (e.g. `#SR-1001`) that admins triage here.

## What the screen shows

### Tabs

| Tab | Shows |
| --- | --- |
| **Ongoing** | Open tickets (count badge). |
| **Solved** | Tickets marked Solved (count badge). |
| **All** | Every ticket. |

### Columns

| Column | Description |
| --- | --- |
| Ticket | Ticket number, e.g. `#SR-1001` (sortable). |
| Reported by | Name, role (e.g. Vendor, Cashboy) and phone. |
| Problem | Problem type (e.g. App closed, Screen stuck, Upload failed, Blank page) and the reporter's description (sortable). |
| Frequency | Every time / Sometimes / Once (sortable). |
| Media | Count of attached screenshots and voice notes. |
| Status | **Sent**, **In review**, **Fixing** or **Solved** (sortable). |
| Replies | Reply count and the latest reply, or "None". |
| Reported | Date/time and how long it has been open (e.g. "open for 3d") (sortable). |

Results are paginated (12 per page by default).

## Filters & search

- **Tabs** — Ongoing / Solved / All.
- **Search** — ticket number, vendor name or phone.
- Click a column header to sort.

## Ticket detail panel

Click a row to open the ticket panel:

| Section | Contents |
| --- | --- |
| Header | Ticket number, status badge, reported time and — for solved tickets — the solved time. |
| Reported by | Name, role, phone and email. |
| What happened | Problem type, frequency and description. |
| Attachments | Screenshots (click to open full size) and voice notes. |
| **Update status** | Sent · In review · Fixing · Solved. |
| **Reply log** | Previous replies with status at the time, timestamp and admin name. |
| **Message to the vendor** / **Add another reply** | Up to 2,000 characters. Shown to the vendor under their report. Labelled *Message to the vendor* when the ticket has no replies yet, *Add another reply* once a reply log exists. |

Click **Save changes** to apply the status change and reply, or **Cancel** to close.

<Steps>
<Step title="Open the ticket" icon="ticket" title-type="p">
Start with the oldest tickets in **Ongoing** — the "open for" age shows what has waited longest.
</Step>
<Step title="Review the evidence" icon="image" title-type="p">
Check the description, frequency, screenshots and voice notes. Reproduce the issue if possible.
</Step>
<Step title="Update status and reply" icon="message-square" title-type="p">
Move the ticket to **In review** or **Fixing** and add a reply so the vendor knows it is being worked on. Mark **Solved** once fixed.
</Step>
</Steps>
